text:
The Vantry maglev prototype reached a top speed of 380 km/h on 14 March 2031, according to Test Report VT-P2-117, certified by the Halvern Rail Standards Board.

The run took place at the Corrowen Test Loop, on a 14.2 km stretch of straight guideway. The report states that the prototype held 380 km/h for about 11 seconds.

Dr. Isela Marwick, Chief Test Engineer at Vantry Transit Systems, supervised the run and confirmed the reading. The certified report records the figure as the highest speed achieved by the vehicle to date.

The document is the formal record of the test and has been certified by the standards board. The Continental Record has relied on its contents for the figures and dates given here.
